title: diff-shared.config.json
description: Source-of-truth configuration for diff-shared.sh: the default diff/merge tools and the set of files with shared content across vm2 repositories.

diff.description: The default diff tool/command diff-shared.sh uses when neither a Git-configured nor a repo-customized diff tool is available.

merge.description: The default merge tool/command diff-shared.sh uses when neither a Git-configured nor a repo-customized merge tool is available.

files.description: The set of files with shared content, each mapping a canonical source-of-truth file to its target location and the default action to take.

tool.description: The name of the tool as it would be invoked on PATH (e.g. 'delta', 'code').

command.description: The full command line template used to invoke the tool. May reference $LOCAL/$REMOTE (diff) or $LOCAL/$REMOTE positions (merge).

sourceFile.description: Path to the canonical source-of-truth file, may contain ${variable} placeholders resolved by diff-shared.sh.

targetFile.description: Path to the corresponding file in the target repository, may contain ${variable} placeholders resolved by diff-shared.sh.

action.description: The default action diff-shared.sh takes for this file when it differs from the source of truth.
